description.value: At 5th level, the time mage gains the ability to control aevum—distinct moments of important time, stolen from the future and used to power the time mage's abilities. When first gained, the time mage must select a single power from a reference list, and has a single aevum per day to spend. He gains additional aevum powers at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and also increases his daily aevum pool by +1 at each of the levels. Spending an aevum is a standard action unless the ability description says otherwise. Available powers include Bolt Time, Entropy, Personal Time, Preferred Timeline, Reverse Timeline, Shatter Time, Temporal Stasis (requires 17th level), Time Cross, and Time Stop (requires 17th level).
